journey.name: Complete focus and review period summaries
journey.description: Use a dedicated test profile with freshly provisioned app data, default four-cycle settings and automatic starts disabled; do not reset or clear a user's personal app data. Complete a one-minute focus after pausing and resuming, then verify the same single completed session in Hoje, Semana, Mês and Ano without duplicates.

actions.action: Verify that 'Foco' and the 'Iniciar' button are visible
Verify that the selected duration is '1 min'
Verify that the 'Diminuir duração' button is disabled
If the 'Receber avisos de sessão' dialog appears, tap 'Permitir'
If Android asks for notification permission, allow notifications
Verify that the 'Continuar' button is visible
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Verify that the remaining time has not changed while paused
Verify that the 'Pausar' button is visible
Verify that 'Pausa curta' and the 'Iniciar' button are visible
Verify that the summary displays '1 min' of focus and '1 Pomodoro concluído'
Verify that exactly one history row shows 'Foco' and 'Concluído'
Scroll to the history period selector
Verify that the summary still shows '1 Pomodoro concluído'
Verify that the weekly chart titled 'Uma semana, um passo de cada vez' is visible
Scroll to the history period selector
Verify that the summary still shows '1 Pomodoro concluído'
Verify that the monthly chart titled 'Sua constância neste mês' is visible
Scroll to the history period selector
Scroll the period selector horizontally until the 'Ano' chip is visible
Verify that the summary still shows '1 Pomodoro concluído'
Verify that the annual chart titled 'Um ano de pequenos avanços' is visible
Verify that the summary still displays '1 Pomodoro concluído'
